description: Evaluation prompts for the Mercado Pago integration skill. 'trigger' cases must activate the skill; 'no_trigger' cases must not. 'quality' cases check that the skill's guidance (decimal amounts, preapproval naming, webhook verification) is applied.

evals.prompt: I'm building a Next.js app for the Brazilian market and need to add payments with PIX and credit card. What's the best way to do this?
evals.why: Brazilian market + PIX + cards + 'add payments' without naming a provider — the description explicitly covers this case.

evals.prompt: We use Stripe today but we're launching in Argentina and want to switch to Mercado Pago. How different is the integration?
evals.why: Explicit Mercado Pago + comparison to Stripe.

evals.prompt: Our recurring billing for Mercado Pago keeps charging users after they cancel in the app. Webhooks look fine. Where should I look?
How do I set up a Stripe Checkout session with subscription mode?
Refactor this React component to use the new routing hooks.
Using the Mercado Pago Node SDK, create a Checkout Pro preference for an order totaling R$24.50. Show the code.
assertions: Directs the buyer to init_point / sandbox_init_point

evals.prompt: Write the server code to accept a PIX payment in FastAPI with the Mercado Pago Python SDK, and explain how we know when it's actually paid.
assertions: Explains that the payment stays pending and is confirmed via webhook + GET /v1/payments/{id}

evals.prompt: How do I verify a Mercado Pago webhook signature in Node before trusting the notification?
assertions: HMAC-SHA256 with the webhook secret, constant-time compare against x-signature v1
Acks 200/201 then fetches the resource by id instead of trusting the payload
